author: SolDex
quote:
The gameplay is fun, but the intended way to play it is not. This is just GTA V.V.

 The relationship is not optional, it is unavoidable and alters the story missions heavily. If you want the good ending one has to save up a massive amount of unspendable money that cannot be used to have fun in the game. All the while you have to say sorry to people as you rob or beat them to not be a 'mean guy.'

There are also no cheat codes available to use until the post game and even then you cannot save with them active. Which is already annoying in a single player, sandbox, chaos game. However, having it be post game content and have challanges to unlock the pointless fun stuff is even more annoying. 

Games used to waste your time being so fun you couldn't set them down. Nowadays the makers of Triple-A games seem to make it their mission to have you waste time doing chores. And I know, the joke it chore simulator, but it is a chore to do anything. I just want a game I can turn on, have fun and turn off whenever I feel like it.  I do have a life and hobbies are just hobbies, it would help if they were fun.
